title: Warden Hanvar
summary: Warden Hanvar's guards control how far the raid can lower his health.
overview: Guard kills lower Hanvar's enforced health floor by five percentage points each. The raid needs twenty guard kills to remove the floor completely, while keeping the guards from sacrificing themselves.

phases.label: Protected warden
phases.description: Kill the five initial guards to begin lowering the floor.

phases.label: Returning guards
phases.description: Kill replacement guards before their sacrifice timer completes; each death lowers the floor by another five points.

phases.label: Unprotected warden
phases.description: The floor reaches zero and the encounter stops requesting further replacements. Finish Hanvar.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Kill guards promptly: each actual guard death lowers the protected health floor by five points.
A guard sacrifice casts Feedback Dispersion without advancing the kill count.
Continue until twenty guard kills remove the health floor, then finish Hanvar.
Keep the boss inside his encounter area and maintain healing through Chains and Wail of Anguish.
